findings.title: Boolean model-envelope schemaVersion is accepted as integer version 1
findings.claim: The candidate enforces the exact 15-key model response envelope but does not enforce the exact JSON type of schemaVersion. A hash-pinned model-assisted envelope whose schemaVersion is the JSON boolean true is accepted as version 1 and its exact substantive review payload is consumed without any validation failure.

evidence.detail: MODEL_RESPONSE_KEYS closes the key set, but valid_model_response_envelope checks body.get("schemaVersion") == 1. Python equality treats True and 1 as equal, so the required integer type is not enforced.
validate_reviewer strict-parses the raw response, accepts the envelope when valid_model_response_envelope returns true, and then returns body.review for substantive lane binding.

The full-path model-envelope-wrong-type-schemaVersion case passed with failureCount 0 after changing only schemaVersion from JSON number 1 to JSON boolean true and recomputing the response/downstream hashes.

steps: Start from the passing model-assisted blind-lane fixture whose raw response contains the exact sealed review payload.
Change only outer schemaVersion from JSON number 1 to JSON boolean true.
Recompute the raw-response SHA-256 and all dependent artifact hashes, then invoke validate().
reproduction.expected: The wrong JSON type must produce a normal validation failure and the review payload must not be consumed.

findings.minimalFix: Require type(schemaVersion) is int and schemaVersion == 1, or validate the envelope with a strict JSON Schema using type integer plus const 1 and additionalProperties false. Add committed boolean-true and numeric-1.0 negative controls; isinstance(value, int) alone is insufficient because bool subclasses int.

scopeChecks.detail: All 15 individually missing-key cases failed normally. The additional-property plus array-valued schemaVersion case also failed normally.
Fourteen of fifteen wrong-type field cases failed normally. Boolean true for schemaVersion passed, establishing S5-C3-001.

scopeChecks.topic: Strict artifact schema and non-crashing failure behavior
scopeChecks.detail: All packet, completeness, blind, comparison, and result additional-property cases failed normally; all fifteen array/null/string top-level artifact cases failed normally; both ordinary wrong-type cases and all seven prior unhashable ID/reference/severity representatives failed normally. The 79-case specialty probe recorded zero crashes.
Committed controls passed, and validate() now returns a structured failure before object access when either top-level input is not a JSON object.
A duplicate key in an agent raw response and a duplicate key in a comparison artifact both failed strict parsing without exceptions.

Across completeness, blind derivation, comparison, and verification, all eight exact controls passed and all eight hash-pinned unrelated-nonempty mutations failed for both agent and model-assisted response forms.

candidateDiffAssessment.detail: Candidate 3 closes the model-envelope key set, stops lane semantic validation after schema failure, handles non-object manifest/progress inputs, and preserves exact binding in every lane. The equality-based schemaVersion check leaves one exact-type hole.
